name: Slot inventory
author: Alexandria
summary: Characters carry a number of items equal to their Strength score; bulky things take two slots.

rules.text: A character carries **items equal to their Strength score**. Most items take **1 slot**; heavy armour, two-handed weapons and big bundles take **2**; small things (rings, a potion or two, 100 coins) take none. Past the limit you are **encumbered** (speed -10 feet and disadvantage on Dexterity checks).

assistant.dm: Slot inventory is on: a character carries items equal to their Strength score, bulky items take 2 slots, tiny ones none; over the limit means speed -10 feet and disadvantage on Dexterity checks. Use it when the party picks up loot.
assistant.player: At this table you carry items equal to your Strength score (bulky ones count as 2), so pick what to bring. Over that you are slowed.
